name: Giant Crab
otherStatistics: Natural armor. Stealth +4. Blindsight 30 ft. Passive Perception 9. No listed languages.
appearance: A broad-shelled crab with a mottled rust and slate carapace, compact stalked eyes, long jointed walking legs and two heavy pincers.

sections.Printed source: Wizards of the Coast, Basic Rules (2018), D&D Basic Rules v1.0, November 2018, and printed p. 131.
sections.Traits: Amphibious. The crab can breathe in air or water.
sections.Actions: Claw. Melee weapon attack, +3 to hit with 5-ft. reach against one target. A hit deals 4 (1d6 + 1) bludgeoning damage and grapples the target. The escape DC is 11. Each of the crab’s two claws can grapple one target.

name: Giant Crocodile
otherStatistics: Natural armor. Stealth +5. Passive Perception 10. No listed special senses or languages.
appearance: A huge dark olive-brown crocodile with a wide toothed muzzle, a thick scuted back, stocky clawed feet and a long tapered tail.

sections.Printed source: Wizards of the Coast, Basic Rules (2018), D&D Basic Rules v1.0, November 2018, and printed p. 132.
sections.Traits: Hold Breath. The crocodile can hold its breath for 30 minutes.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make one Bite and one Tail attack.
Bite. Melee weapon attack, +8 to hit with 5-ft. reach against one target. A hit deals 21 (3d10 + 5) piercing damage and grapples the target, with escape DC 16. Until the grapple ends, the target is restrained and the crocodile cannot Bite another target.
Tail. Melee weapon attack, +8 to hit with 10-ft. reach against one target the crocodile is not grappling. A hit deals 14 (2d8 + 5) bludgeoning damage. A creature hit this way must pass a DC 16 Strength save or fall prone.

name: Giant Eagle
otherStatistics: Perception +4. Passive Perception 14. Speaks Giant Eagle. Understands Common and Auran without speaking them. No listed special senses.
appearance: A golden-brown raptor with tawny neck feathers, a hooked beak, broad dark wings and powerful talons.

sections.Printed source: Wizards of the Coast, Basic Rules (2018), D&D Basic Rules v1.0, November 2018, and printed p. 132.
sections.Traits: Keen Sight. The eagle has advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on sight.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make one Beak and one Talons attack.
Beak. Melee weapon attack, +5 to hit with 5-ft. reach against one target. A hit deals 6 (1d6 + 3) piercing damage.
Talons. Melee weapon attack, +5 to hit with 5-ft. reach against one target. A hit deals 10 (2d6 + 3) slashing damage.
